cards.name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
cards.oracleText: Sarkhan's Catharsis deals 5 damage to target player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Whelp
cards.oracleText:
Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
Whenever you activate an ability of a Sarkhan planeswalker, this creature deals 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Dragonfire
cards.oracleText:
Sarkhan's Dragonfire deals 3 damage to any target.
Look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a red card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Rage
cards.oracleText: Sarkhan's Rage deals 5 damage to any target. If you control no Dragons, Sarkhan's Rage deals 2 damage to you.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Unsealing
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 4, 5, or 6, this enchantment deals 4 damage to any target.
Whenever you cast a creature spell with power 7 or greater, this enchantment deals 4 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.

cards.name: Sarkhan, Soul Aflame
cards.oracleText:
Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever a Dragon you control enters, you may have Sarkhan become a copy of it until end of turn, except its name is Sarkhan, Soul Aflame and it's legendary in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Sarkhan Vol
cards.oracleText:
+1: Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain haste until end of turn.
−2: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
−6: Create five 4/4 red Dragon creature tokens with flying.

cards.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker Emblem
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of your draw step, draw two additional cards.
At the beginning of your end step, discard your hand.

cards.name: Sarkhan the Mad
cards.oracleText:
0: Reveal the top card of your library and put it into your hand. Sarkhan deals damage to himself equal to that card's mana value.
−2: Target creature's controller sacrifices it, then that player creates a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.
−4: Each Dragon creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Sarkhan, Fireblood
cards.oracleText:
+1: You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
+1: Add two mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells.
−7: Create four 5/5 red Dragon creature tokens with flying.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Triumph
cards.oracleText: Search your library for a Dragon creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
cards.oracleText:
+1: Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a legendary 4/4 red Dragon creature with flying, indestructible, and haste. (He doesn't lose loyalty while he's not a planeswalker.)
−3: Sarkhan deals 4 damage to target creature.
−6: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your draw step, draw two additional cards" and "At the beginning of your end step, discard your hand."

cards.name: Sarkhan Unbroken
cards.oracleText:
+1: Draw a card, then add one mana of any color.
−2: Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
−8: Search your library for any number of Dragon creature cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

cards.name: Sarkhan, Dragon Ascendant
cards.oracleText:
When Sarkhan enters, you may behold a Dragon. If you do, create a Treasure token. (To behold a Dragon, choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand.)
Whenever a Dragon you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Sarkhan. Until end of turn, Sarkhan becomes a Dragon in addition to its other types and gains flying.

cards.name: Sarkhan, Dragonsoul
cards.oracleText:
+2: Sarkhan deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature your opponents control.
−3: Sarkhan deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker.
−9: Search your library for any number of Dragon creature cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

cards.name: Sarkhan the Masterless
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, each Dragon you control deals 1 damage to that creature.
+1: Until end of turn, each planeswalker you control becomes a 4/4 red Dragon creature and gains flying.
−3: Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.

cards.name: Sarkhan, Wanderer to Shiv
cards.oracleText:
+1: Dragon cards in your hand perpetually gain "This spell costs {1} less to cast," and "You may pay {X} rather than pay this spell's mana cost, where X is its mana value."
+1: Conjure a card named Shivan Dragon into your hand.
−2: Sarkhan, Wanderer to Shiv deals 3 damage to target creature.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Resolve
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
• Destroy target creature with flying.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Scorn
cards.oracleText: Sarkhan's Scorn deals damage equal to the number of turns you have begun to target creature or planeswalker.
